description: Server modules that decode their own commands before the server's Command enum sees the line (p05-ipc queue Q2). check-spec-inventory.py reads the names and the authority; check-sdk-schema.py reads the request fields. enum: the module's #[serde(tag = "cmd")] enum, each variant named with #[serde(rename = "...")]. envelope: the struct that flattens the enum; its other fields (minus the reply id) every variant accepts. enum_handler: the function that dispatches the enum. literals: commands the module matches by name, with their request struct and handler. refused_envelope_fields: envelope fields a command's handler refuses before decoding. authority: the profile of every command; local-admin needs the non-Unix refusal in enum_handler and in every literal handler.
